docs.text: The Jakarta Method It has a focus on [[America]]'s influence over [[Indonesia]] and [[Brazil]] during the [[Cold War]]. It has talked a lot about the [[CIA]], Indonesian president [[Sukarno]], it just covered the coup of [[Suharto]]. It has stressed the importance of the [[Bandung Conference]]. It talks about the [[PKI]]. People: [[Frank Wisner]] - Early architect of CIA covert operations after WW2. - Silver spoon, sundown town? [[Allen Dulles]] - CIA Director 1953-1961 [[Joao Goulart]] (Jango) - Nationalist reformer. "Basic Reforms" that scared the country. - Land redistribution - Limits on foreign ownership - Expanding voting rights - Stronger labor protections - Educational reforms. - Military was afraid of him expanding the rigths of lower-ranking military personnel - [[Operation Brother Sam]] would have supplied weapons/fuel. Wasn't needed. - Jango chose not to begin a civil war thinking he might be re-elected. He was not. Thoughts Staging a sex tape of a world leader Hiring bald Mexican guy. Nobody cared. never released tapes. Fake Vampire attacks. Indonesian military training in the U.S. getting good salaries, spending it on groceries and making Indonesian food for the college kids studying abroad. Even though they're being trained to fight against their government as anti-communist generals. Sitcom plot where one character is doing a special operation coup and another is acting ambassador trying to convince them they have no involvement. Then discovering they do have involvement and having to stick with the story. Further Questions Remember what it said about the Congolese president. What was going on with Malaysia? A New American Age "The third world" started as an energetic and optimistic term. The "Second world" was Russia. Independent Indonesia President [[Sukarno]]. Promoting Nationalism, anti-colonialism, and political independence. Doesn't fully align with either superpower Hosted the [[Bandung Conference]]. With other "Third World" countries. Non-aligned. forging their own path. Didn't want to come off as hostile to America so referenced Paul Revere. [[PKI]] is large. Feet to the Fire, Pope in the Sky. [[Eizenhower]] admin was nervous about Sukarno. [[CIA]] emerging. Referencing the British [[M16]] and [[James Bond]]. [[Howard P. Jones]] "Smiling Jones" was friends with Sukarno. Did not know about American involvement backing coup. CIA backed rebelions against governments in the developing world. Fake Vampire. An Alliance for Progress [[Cuban Revolution]] scared Washington. [[John F. Kennedy]] launched the [[Alliance for Progress]]. Encourage economic development while limiting revolutionary movements. Especially buddying up to militaries and anti-communist beliefs. To Brazil and Back Military overthrew [[Joao Goulart]] in 1964. Brazilian officers shared counterinsurgency ideas. Brazil served as a model. The September 30th Movement [[Konfrontasi]] Myanmar. digging heels in the ground (good.) Sept 30, 1965. Officers kidnapped and killed indonesian generals. Major General Suharto took command. PKI (Communist Party of Indonesia) was blamed for the coup. Suharto put out a mass propaganda campaign. Reds lurking under beds. Women sexually torturing generals. Witchcraft. Extermination Time slows down. talking about times in terms of weeks, specific dates, hours, minutes. Magdelena being accused by the police of being a collaborator for her role in the union. her denial was proof she was one of the secretive women who danced naked. she was 17. she was questioned for weeks and then raped. festive reunion with other communist party friends in jail, not knowing something was horribly wrong. Then them disappearing overnight. sorting through bodies at mass burial sites. trying to recognize people. 5% of the population of [[Bali]] was killed. Machetes weren't native to Bali. tourist hotel at a killing beach. running amok as an orientalist word. people couldn't talk to each other with their friends. a quarter of the country was associated with the [[PKI]]. Managers of plantations gave names of troublesome communists Washington shares guilt. Several points- Washington provided pressure US strategy has been to destroy communist party for being popular. US govt. launched secret attacks in 1958. adopted howard jones strat of collaving with military. Washington instructed agents to destabilize party Spread propaganda propped up military. Prodded military to take over government knowing that it involved mass killings. Killing the communists was something that would make Washington happy. Global PRC - Guatemala faced first dissapearances. Ghana. "Gold Coast" named after commodities. What is his name? He helped create Ghana. Socialist. Like Sukarno. [[Kwame Nkrumah]]. [[Nehru]]. Chile. US funding election. dollar per vote. Chile. Alyende. Kissinger. Terrorism started before he took office. "Make the economy scream." 2 tracks. Economic warefare. Then Salvador Allende. Chile coup. Jakarta threats. Sailors tortured for leaking it. Airforce bombarded palace. he shot himself in the head. Lie and say the prisoners tried to rebel Student interview- enraging cruel military guy and he spews the whole plan, then threatens them. [[Ronald Reagan]] Operation Lotus in East Timoor- not justified. A third of the population pol pot- cambodia. Khmer rouge Contras [[Bay of Pigs]] Reagan Argentina Anti-Sandanistas Counter-insurgency anti-communist schools in panama and taiwan You didn’t need US invasion to do anti-communism [[Guatemala]]: 1954 CIA-Backed overthrow of [[Jacobo Arbenz]]. His land reform threatened United Fruit Company. The Jakarta Method [[Chile]] [[Salvador Allende]] elected president 1970. Socialist democratically elected. Hadn’t taken office before US decided to tear him down. Destabilized economy, supported military overthrow. Eventual 1973 Coup where Allende killed himself. Replaced with [[Augusto Pinochet]]. Allende killed himeslf during the Coup. Chile became testing for Radical Neoliberal Economic Policy with the [[Chicago Boys]]. [[Richard Nixon]] [[Henry Kissinger]] [[Operation Condor]] How Latin American Dictatorships cooperated. Included Chile Argentina Urugway Paraguay Bolivia Brazil Back Up North Southeast Asia and the Vietnam War. [[The Phoenix Program]] US attempt to identify and eliminate the Viet Cong's civilian political infrastructure. Intelligence gathering interrogation detention assassination Cambodia [[Pol Pot]] and [[Khmer Rouge]] came to power. Khmer Rouge were communist revolutionaries. Dictators Suharto- Indonesia Pinochet- Chile Ferdinand Marcos- Philippines.
